dispatch.summary: T042 meets ARCH-5 (r8) and CLUB-20 (r16). Commit 22b9e8c changes the four draws (owner requests, caretaker managers, campaigns and outgoing bids) so they are named by what they settle and the game date instead of `w.revision`. In non-test engine source, `w.revision` now appears only in counter increments and its `revision: 0` start, and no other draw key counts commands or reads inbox or event lengths. I checked by reading the code that none of the new keys can repeat. Owner requests: a cooldown read from the event log blocks a second use of a request in the same year and round, because every cooldown is at least 1. Caretakers: the departure count includes the departure just recorded, and the engine never trims events (the save codec keeps the event count). Campaigns: an active campaign blocks a second one of the same kind, and campaigns only settle when a round advances. Bids: `pruneBids` only runs in `dailyMarket`, so no bid is pruned between two bids on the same day, and the ID includes the day. As the impl notes require, campaigns and bids already in saves keep their old IDs, and old campaign results still draw from the stored ID. The new tests in transfers.test.ts, care.test.ts and operations.test.ts would fail on the old revision-keyed code. They compare worlds with and without extra reads, including a whole-world `canonical` match after a bid is answered. No other code parses these IDs, and the save schema treats them as plain strings. I did not run the test suites in this read-only review; the worker reported typecheck and the full unit suite passing (73 files, 501 tests). Portable goldens are left for T047, as the task says.

reviewHistory.summary: T042: draws and the IDs that feed them no longer use `w.revision`. In engine source (excluding tests), `w.revision` now appears only in counter increments and its `revision: 0` start. Checks on whether the new keys are unique: (1) every care cooldown is above 0, so `careOffer` blocks a second request of a kind in the same year and round. (2) Departure events are never trimmed and the count includes the current departure, so two caretakers on the same day still get different keys. (3) The `w.campaigns.some(kind)` check blocks a second campaign of a kind. `settleRound` runs only from `advanceRound`, so a campaign can't finish and restart within one round. (4) `pruneBids` runs only in `dailyMarket`, so within a day the count n only grows. Old saved IDs keep their stored form, and nothing parses ID strings. The new tests would fail on the old code. One of them compares the whole world, ignoring the revision counter, after a bid is answered. The worker reports typecheck and unit tests passing; this review checked the code and did not rerun the tests. As the T042 notes say, the portable goldens and the rules version bump are left to T047.

The failure output pointed at the test's `it(` line rather than an assertion, which suggests the 30 s timeout. That test passed on the two later full runs and alone in 13.6 s.
- The five new amateur-exchange tests in season.test.ts and the capacity-conservation test in world.test.ts pass (18 tests run).
- eslint and prettier pass on the changed files.
- LEAGUE did not change on the group branch: its newest commit (3596812) only rewords docs.

변경 내용:
- progression.ts: 저장이 끝날 때까지 다음 걸음을 막던 조건을 없앴습니다. 명령은 여전히 한 번에 하나씩만 보냅니다(inFlight/processing). 밀린 날짜는 직전 걸음 자체가 속도보다 오래 걸렸을 때나 자리를 비웠다 돌아왔을 때만 갚습니다. 그래서 x10에서도 평소에는 한 걸음에 하루씩 갑니다. 시계가 멈추면 이유와 상관없이 바로 저장하고, 멈춘 뒤에 도착한 걸음의 결과도 저장합니다.
- client.ts: 이제 어떤 명령도 저장을 기다리지 않습니다.
  - 소유자 결정(명령, 창단, 알림 확인)은 `saveSoon()`으로 바로 백그라운드 저장을 요청합니다.
  - 자동 진행은 저장되지 않은 구간마다 30초(`AUTOSAVE_MS`) 타이머를 하나 겁니다.
  - 상태에 `savedAt`과 `saveFailed`를 추가했습니다.
  - 백그라운드 저장 요청은 긴 명령 뒤에 줄을 설 수 있습니다. 그래서 15초 워커 감시 시간이 잘못 터지지 않도록 저장 요청에는 체크포인트 감시 시간(60초)을 씁니다.
  - 게임 삭제(forget)와 종료(dispose) 때 자동 저장 타이머를 해제합니다.
- App.tsx: 탭이 숨겨질 때와 `pagehide` 때 바로 저장합니다. 저장 상태는 모두 저장됐으면 `저장 완료`, 아니면 `방금 저장`/`n초 전 저장`으로 보입니다. 이 탭에서 한 번도 저장하지 않았으면 `저장 대기`입니다. `저장 재시도` 버튼은 저장이 실패했을 때만 나옵니다.
- 테스트:
  - progression.test: 가짜 타이머로 x10에서 20ms 명령과 0.8초 저장을 돌려, 100ms마다 하루씩 진행하고 저장을 기다리지 않으며 멈추면 저장한다는 것을 확인합니다.
  - client.test: 자동 저장 타이머, 결정 직후 바로 저장하되 명령은 기다리지 않는다는 것, 커밋마다 읽기 전용 탭 알림이 가는 것을 확인합니다. 기존 테스트는 비동기 저장에 맞춰 `whenSaved()`를 기다리도록 고쳤습니다.
  - e2e: builds, business, cups-and-club, founding, intervention, milestones, native-touch, news, recruitment에서 새로고침 전에 `저장 완료`를 기다리게 했습니다. recovery의 저장 실패 후 상태 문구 기대값도 바꿨습니다.

dispatch.summary:
T043 is done: day steps, round steps and full-season runs now go through the same days in the same order and record the same facts. Typecheck and the full unit suite pass (73 files, 498 tests).

**What changed in `packages/engine/src/season.ts`**
- `advanceDays` and `advanceRound` now share one internal per-day function, `stepDay`. In its order, the day after round 46 closes the season. A league match day plays the round's matches, then the round settlement, then `clubDay`. Every other day plays its due cup and European ties, then `clubDay`.
- The old round body is now `playRound`, called only on a league match day.
- `advanceRound` steps days until the round count goes up or the club goes bankrupt. Like the old version, it doesn't stop for a critical alert. `advanceDays` keeps its critical, bankrupt and range guards.
- The setup for older saves (calendar, rank history, scorer table) is now a shared `beginDays` helper.
- `closeSeason` moves the calendar to day 323 (`SEASON_END_DAY + 1`) before closing, so every path closes on the same day.

**Tests**
- New test in `calendar.test.ts`, "every progression mode records the same facts". It runs ENG `haeram-demo` and ESP `one-order` for 1.5 seasons three ways: day by day, round by round with `closeSeason` at round 46, and `simulateSeason` then days. All three give the same world once `revision` and `receiptIds` are set aside. The tests take 6.8 s and 5.7 s.
- For `haeram-demo` in round mode, a temporary check showed the day-32 cup tie now comes before the day-35 league match.

- The new test passes `observe=false` to both the day and round loops, which skips match movement frames. An existing test already shows frames don't change results. With frames on, a day-by-day season took about 15 s and the test hit the 30 s timeout.
- The test seeds never trigger a critical alert. If one did, the day-by-day loop would stop on it. The replacement manager after a departure is still drawn using `w.revision` until T042 lands.
- The `test:contract` golden checks were not run or regenerated; T047 does that.
- Three CLI calls were blocked because this session can't approve commands: `work board`, `haeram-spec-creator lint`, and an A/B timing run against the old `season.ts`. So spec lint was not run, and I have no timing baseline from the old code.
